Independently reviewed upstream stb_image 2.30 implementation, externally compiled with non-static stbi exports, stdio, HDR, GIF, 16-bit, zlib and thread-local entry points enabled. C FILE handles and C-call callbacks only.
Official deprecated stb_image_resize 0.97 (resize1), externally compiled with non-static stbir exports. Current resize2 2.18b has a different API and is not interchangeable.
Independently reviewed upstream stb_image_write 1.16 implementation, externally compiled with non-static stbi_write exports, stdio enabled and three genuine mutable settings variables exported.

Independently reviewed upstream stb_vorbis 1.22 implementation, externally compiled with stdio, pushdata, pull decoding and short sample APIs enabled. Sound_Player uses opaque decoder handles; direct private decoder field access requires exact source layout.

Exact reviewed official pl_mpeg header SHA-256 with PL_MPEG_IMPLEMENTATION, stdio enabled, interleaved audio, matching exposed record layouts and all 106 used non-static plm exports including internal helpers. No supplied decoder assets are used.

Genuine rpmalloc 1.4.4 C runtime with RPMALLOC_FIRST_CLASS_HEAPS=1 and compile-time configuration/cache/statistics parameters matching the Jai module. Native callbacks use the real C ABI. Current 2.0.1 changes config/statistics ABI and is not interchangeable.

Genuine RAD Telemetry SDK 3.5.0.147 bootstrap tmGetApi and the pinned 2022.05.23.51766 API table, Windows x64, external library basename rad_tm_win64. Enabled hooks call SDK pointers; disabled hooks intentionally emit no events.
Genuine independently supplied NVIDIA Aftermath SDK API 535 library GFSDK_Aftermath_Lib.x64 with matching callbacks, enums and interfaces. Newer SDK release metadata does not prove ABI compatibility.

Genuine archived NVTT 2.x C++ library matching the reviewed 2.1 header, compiler-specific mangled symbols and public vtable layout. x86-64 only: Itanium hidden result before this; MSVC member hidden result after this. PS5 ABI unavailable.

Genuine MojoShader C library with the pinned legacy full record ABI. Current main header contains 41 of 45 retained foreign names; the four historical compiler/preprocessor procedures require an independently reviewed historical provider, not the current main API by assumption.

Genuine Thekla Atlas C++ library built from official revision e6f034837ca3936c9817958746e9f46f8dd22a75 and matching Itanium/MSVC mangling. Jai bridges pinned options, error enum, debug callback userdata and nonmanifold retry; legacy rich errors and native assertion interception are unavailable from this current API.

Genuine historical Thekla Baker C++ library with exact pinned symbols/layout; no maintained authoritative public upstream source was located, so its native ABI provider remains unreviewed and availability is not established.

rpmalloc ownership queries track live blocks allocated through these Jai wrappers, not arbitrary native span metadata. Direct raw native allocations and freed-block interiors are outside this ownership model.
rpmalloc lifecycle query reflects initialization performed through Jai wrappers. External initialization bypassing the wrappers is not discovered.
meshoptimizer simplification defaults, partitioning and codecs use current upstream algorithms; binary/numeric equivalence to 0.11 is not established.
Telemetry enabled SDK API-table/capture/GPU timestamp behavior remains unexecuted; the 13 no-ops exist only in disabled or non-Windows branches.
64-bit pointer ABI required across this scope. NVTT supports reviewed x86-64 only, and the pinned PS5 NVTT ABI is explicitly unsupported.
